stem:
Aarav's wall clock uses a dry cell that is thrown away when it goes flat. His laptop uses a battery pack that he plugs into a charger and uses again many times.

Which classification is correct?

options.text: The laptop battery is rechargeable; the clock cell is single-use.
Both are rechargeable because both store chemical energy.
The clock cell is rechargeable; the laptop pack is single-use.

teacher.key_rationale: A rechargeable battery can be charged and reused many times; a dry cell in the clock is single-use. Storing chemical energy alone does not make a cell rechargeable.
